item.text: {"analysis":"The host completed all 25 epochs successfully. Best validation HR@10 was 0.635 at epoch 5; NDCG@10 was 0.4018066008983458. Later epochs did not improve the selected checkpoint, suggesting early stopping is useful under this configuration. Without a baseline or ablations, the result does not establish that fusion improved performance or identify which component helped.","code_summary":"One causal NextItNet with 64-dimensional, position-free item embeddings and eight independently parameterized residual blocks using dilations [1,2,4,8,1,2,4,8]. Each block gates between dilated convolution and causal depthwise local filtering with pointwise projection, then applies a second dilated convolution. Pre-layer normalization, GELU, dropout 0.2, and learned per-channel residual scales initialized to 0.1 support stable updates. Input and output item embeddings are shared, with padding masked between blocks. Configuration: MAXLEN=128, KERNEL_SIZE=3, LR=0.001, WEIGHT_DECAY=0.00001, BATCH_SIZE=128."}
